title: Aaalt for dyrt
body:
Jeg downloadede appen men droppede at sætte den op, efter jeg så prisen. Det er jo HELT. VILDT. DYRT!!! 
Havde det kostet 2-300kr, ville jeg nok have prøvet det. Men 800kr… om året… eller 129kr om måneden… det kommer altså ikke til at ske her. Desværre. 
I skriver i jeres svar her, at der findes en gratis app. Hvad hedder den?

author: Ma4lou

title: It is working!
body:
I have to admit, it does get my son to do the things I want him to without a fight!  It is still early, we have only had the app for a few days.  There are some bugs, lost quests, and information on my son’s app (says I have something in review and I do not), and his coin total changed all of a sudden from 22 to 24 without completing a task.  So there are some bugs.  

Kelli
author: KellimarieT

title: Amazing app for kids with adhd and especially when they live in more than one home
body:
My kids love this app. 6 and 10 years old. 
We are a family of two homes, and this app makes the daily schedule much more easy for my oldest kid to watch, understand and follow in both homes which gives him a lot more overview and peace of mind. My okdest kod has a adhd diagnose and he really praices this app himself saying how nice it is for him. 

Irs nice how kids in different age groups can get something different from the app. My youngest kid loves the gamifacation of it and hos little pet, where my oldest kod mostly use it for dayily overview of tasks and plans. 

Its very easy to use the parent side of the app as well. 
In general I can really recomend this app to anyone especially for kids with adhd symptoms. Its a great took for our family in general But especially when our kids shift betweens two homes yet still need some consistency.
author: Kamille (Denmark)

title: More different  languages
body: I wished this app was made for danish kids also.
author: Heidi Bahn

title: Great app. Could be more smooth
body:
My kid who does not have a diagnosis love this app. Five year old. 

It’s a bit hard because it’s in English, but he loves his dragon. 

It makes everything easier and he is so motivated to help the dragon. He learns so much. 

I would like for the app the be more smooth and quick. 

Also it’s very tiresome to confirm the quests have been done over and over. 

Three steps they are confirmed or collected and it’s waaayyyy too much for me. 

1. I wish he didn’t have to collect them again after I have confirmed them. 

2. Also I wish when he has done a quest, he would not have to confirm to have done it. Maybe a swipe from red to green would be easier for everyone. 

3. I wish I didn’t have to confirm he did the chores. But I understand why it’s there if some kids are big and independent and the parents have to check up on it. But it’s not necessary in my current situation- so there is a lot back and forward from the profiles.
